references.text: Moses calls heaven and earth again as witnesses against Israel, setting life and death, blessing and curse before them.
Moses calls heaven and earth as witnesses against the assembly of Israel, with the same theme of cosmic witnesses.
Isaiah calls heaven and earth to hear the Lord's judgment over Israel.
Warning that Israel will perish if they forget the Lord and follow other gods.
Prediction that the people will be uprooted from the land they are entering to take possession of.
Joshua warns that the people will perish from the good land if they turn away from the Lord.
Warning of the Lord's wrath and that they will quickly perish from the good land.
Jeremiah warns Jerusalem of destruction, with a parallel theme of being cut off from the land.
